notes.title: BIG UPDATE!! ENGLISH FULL VOICE added
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the delay, but we did it!

We’ve released the fully English-voiced version, featuring many great voice actors! For more details, please check our website:

https://x.com/BladeWindshift

notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

How's everybody doing?
We'd like to share with you some of the fixes implemented on this latest build.



 English text has been corrected and improved
 Localization improvements
 Event related content is included for future use




We hope that with these improvements, you will have the time to enjoy this story even more.

Get ready for more, we cant wait to share those details.
